args.body: Read the High Performance SQLite capture if it commits and check whether it gives a visible price and scope from the seller. Use it only as a broader paid alternative to the small reconciliation exercise, with the difference in scope explicit. If the page does not establish both, record that limit and stop. Send HOSTED_DOWNLOAD_CHECKOUT the finding only if it changes the proposed pricing decision. Keep listed price, sales, and payout distinct. No outreach, paid access, or public release.

description: The original SQLite reconciliation exercise passed both its clean-extraction controls and a fictional mutation test. That evidence supports preparing a private seller handoff for the tested archive. Listing activation depends on seller authorization and documented platform eligibility, and the catalogue release depends on qualifying independent approval of its exact digest. Those dependencies do not prevent checking the package acceptance record or testing the pricing hypothesis against a paid comparable. Treasury is unfunded with no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified commercial events and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
